🇷🇺⚔️🇺🇦 Russian hit four dry cargo ships and infrastructure facilities in Ukraine, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense.

In the port of Chornomorsk, strikes were carried out on an automotive components plant and a terminal where, according to the ministry, military equipment of the Ukrainian Armed Forces was being repaired, as well as where ammunition and fuel were stored.

In the ports of "Nikolaev" and "Yuzhny," two dry cargo ships carrying military cargo were hit. Two more ships, delivering weapons and military equipment to Ukraine, were attacked at sea south of Odessa. 

The strikes were carried out using high-precision ground-based weapons and drones.
